summary: Jinxin Technology Holding Co, a Shanghai-based education services foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K containing its interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The XBRL-tagged filing discloses segment, revenue, tax, lease, and concentration data, plus references to HK Education Vision Holding Co Limited and share option plans, but announces no transaction. No stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock appears. This is a routine periodic report, not a special situation; watch for any later deal-announcement 6-K.
